Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Learned controls: click(0.2,0.6) attaches yellow diamond to knight shield (success observed last execution); proceed(0.78,0.48) closes Spoils! & detaches diamond to right (~0.75,0.45); settings(0.15,0.72) toggles menu. Mechanics: center popup 'Chests will always drop a relic.', left knight sword-raised, gold=119 constant, diamonds float L/R. Navigation: popups center, diamonds L/R, settings L/bottom. Failed strategies: repeated proceed/settings loops; non-attaching clicks/drags at(0.75,0.5)/(0.25,0.45). Active goals: attach diamond relic to knight shield (post-proceed detach). Observed evidence: knight pose, Spoils! text, gold119, Proceed L/R, attach success(0.2,0.6), floating diamond(0.25,0.45) post-fails, popup persist post-proceed, recent click(0.2,0.6) completed, new floating diamond on right (~0.75,0.45) post-proceed. Hypothesis: 0.2,0.6 attaches current floating diamond to shield (consistent with prior successes). Uncertainty: attachment may detach on Proceed; distinguish observed evidence from guesses. No private state inferred. Evidence from screenshots/clicks only.
